title: Camera Broken
intro: You have chatted with the same person for weeks. Every time you ask for a video call, there is a reason.
Tap anything that looks odd to sniff it closer. Pin what is suspicious, clear what is harmless.
When you are sure, decide what to do.

msg.text: my bank card is blocked abroad

msg: . Could you send me a little for

msg.text: a new phone and a ticket to visit you
You are the only one I trust.

call.label: They will not appear on video
call.why: A person who never appears on camera may not be real.

mic.label: No voice either
mic.why: Never speaking is a red flag.

money.label: A money request
money.lens: A blocked bank card, so they need yours.
money.why: Never send money to someone you have not met.

why.label: A ticket to visit you
why.why: The reason is made to feel kind.

trust.label: "You are the only one I trust"
trust.lens: They make you feel special and responsible.

profile.label: Weeks of chatting
profile.why: Time alone does not prove it is real. Scammers are patient.

actions.label: Send him the money for the phone and ticket
Insist on a video call, and send nothing until we meet
Stop, send nothing and report the profile

block_report.line: You stopped and reported. The profile was removed, and you lost nothing.

verify.line: You said no money until a video call. The chat went quiet and the profile vanished. Case cracked.

go_ahead.line: The money was lost. Then there was "customs" trouble and another request, then another.

what_if.go_ahead: Never sending money to someone you have not met was the exit. A broken camera for six weeks is a warning.
what_if.verify: Checking was smart. Reporting it as well helps protect other people.

golden_rule: Never send money to someone you have not met in person, however long you have chatted.

quick_check.q: After six weeks of chat, a person with a "broken camera" asks you for money. What do you do?

options.text: Send a little, they need help
Ask a friend to send it

quick_check.explain: Never send money to someone you have not met. A long chat is not proof.

hints.nudge: In six weeks, have you ever seen or heard them?

rows.k: Send money to an online love interest?
Living far away, and asking for money
